name: delivery
description: You supply intent and a design seed; the plugin runs research, evidence-graded user personas, simulated interviews and journey walks, PRD, MVP staging, design system, architecture, roadmap and stories — then scopes a sprint, hands it to an external implementation runner (superpowers or your own), independently reviews acceptance, and re-aligns the plan. Builds through a shipping team of role sessions (Chief of Staff, Product Manager, Delivery Manager, builders), or hands each sprint to your own runner.
